data.method: Stat-only Performance Score (0-100). Hitters: OPS 50%, OBP 20%, SLG 15%, playing time 15%, percentiles vs MLB hitters with 200+ PA. Starters (10+ GS, 60+ IP): ERA 35%, WHIP 30%, K/9 20%, BB/9 15% vs qualified starters. Relievers (30+ IP, <5 GS): ERA 35%, WHIP 25%, K/9 25%, BB/9 15%. Rank is within position group. No scouting input.
